name: Popular Writing
description: The politics of writing and knowing: power-knowledge relations; knowledge for what? Knowledge for whom? Extractivism in research; gatekeeping, representation, epistemic injustice; academic elitism, peer-review politics, journal access barriers; open access, paid and predatory publications; popular writing; public intellectuals and the crisis; popular writing as epistemic resistance; decolonizing knowledge; popular writing: ethics, responsibility, community empowerment, inclusivity, accountability, reflection, and positionality; how to tell a great story; different genres of popular writing; publishing, pitching, editing, and different venues.
